metadata.title: 360-Degree Sovereign Trade Blueprints & Triangulation Master
metadata.description: Cross-referenced statutory and commercial dossiers integrating all 18 trade providers across Mandi, Customs, Freight, Trade Finance, Export Councils, and Multilateral Treaties.

corridors.variety_grade: Nizamabad / Salem Double Polished Finger Turmeric

statutory_formalities.name: Entity Incorporation & Udyam MSME Registration
statutory_formalities.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
statutory_formalities.details: Register Sole Proprietorship, LLP, or Pvt Ltd. Yields Priority Sector Lending (PSL) status for bank packing credit.

statutory_formalities.name: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN)
statutory_formalities.details: Mandatory for inter-state movement and zero-rated export supplies under Letter of Undertaking (LUT).

statutory_formalities.name: DGFT Importer-Exporter Code (IEC)
statutory_formalities.details: 10-digit lifetime PAN-based identifier mandatory for ICEGATE customs shipping bill filings.

statutory_formalities.name: Spices Board Certificate of Registration as Exporter of Spices (CRES)
statutory_formalities.authority: Spices Board of India (Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
statutory_formalities.details: Statutory registration under Section 11 of Spices Board Act, 1986. Mandatory for clearing shipping bills for turmeric (HS 0910).

statutory_formalities.name: FSSAI Central Exporter License
statutory_formalities.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI FoSCoS)
statutory_formalities.details: Central food licensing for export premises, grading sheds, and food storage units.

statutory_formalities.name: AD Code Registration & ICEGATE Portal Onboarding
statutory_formalities.details: Link bank Authorized Dealer (AD) code to JNPT / Chennai port custom locations for direct foreign inward remittances and e-BRC realization.

sourcing_and_mandi.primary_mandi: Nizamabad APMC (World's largest Turmeric exchange) & Duggirala Mandi

quality_specs.moisture_limit: Max 10.0% (Prevents mold and aflatoxin proliferation during sea transit)
quality_specs.lead_chromate: Strict Zero Tolerance (Prohibited artificial yellow polishing agent)

quality_and_lab_gateway.target_standards: Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) Regulation GSO 1016/2014 & CODEX STAN 326

key_parameters.importance: Strict screening against lead chromate powder

authorized_nabl_labs: Spices Board Quality Evaluation Laboratory (QEL), Guntur (Andhra Pradesh)
Intertek India Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad Food Testing Facility

plant_quarantine_pqis.authority: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS), Ministry of Agriculture
plant_quarantine_pqis.certificate_type: e-Phyto (Electronic Phytosanitary Certificate) under IPPC Standards
plant_quarantine_pqis.inspection_hub: Plant Quarantine Station at ICD Sanathnagar (Hyderabad) or JNPT Port Station
plant_quarantine_pqis.fumigation_protocol: Methyl Bromide (MBr) @ 32 g/m³ for 24h at 21°C or Phosphine (PH3) @ 2 g/m³ for 120h by accredited pest control operator (NSPM-12 / NSPM-22 compliant)

multimodal_logistics.recommended_route: Madhira / Nizamabad Packhouse -> Road Haulage to ICD Sanathnagar (Hyderabad) -> CONCOR DFC Rail Freight to JNPT Port (Nhava Sheva, Mumbai) -> Ocean Transit to Jeddah Islamic Port (Saudi Arabia)
multimodal_logistics.port_of_discharge: Jeddah Islamic Port (SAJED) / King Abdulaziz Port, Dammam (SADMM)
multimodal_logistics.container_spec: 1 x 20ft Standard Dry Container (20 MT payload in 25kg / 50kg PP bags with inner liners)
multimodal_logistics.free_time_at_pod: 14 Days Container Free-Time at Jeddah Port

trade_finance_and_risk.ecgc_short_term_policy: ECGC SCR (Shipments Comprehensive Risks) Policy (90% non-payment cover)
trade_finance_and_risk.recommended_payment_term: 30% Advance T/T + 70% Irrevocable Confirmed Letter of Credit (LC at Sight) under UCP 600
trade_finance_and_risk.working_capital_financing: Pre-shipment Bank Packing Credit in INR at 8.5% p.a. (subsidized by 3% under RBI MSME Interest Equalisation Scheme IES to net 5.5%)
trade_finance_and_risk.post_shipment_factoring: TReDS / ITFS Reverse Factoring within 24h of Shipping Bill Generation

buyer_discovery_and_demand.demand_season: Year-round high demand with peak procurement before Ramadan & wedding season
buyer_archetypes: Wholesale Spice & Dry Food Importers in Batha Market (Riyadh) and Bab Makkah (Jeddah)
Supermarket / Hypermarket Chains (e.g. LuLu Group Saudi Hypermarkets, Panda Retail Company, Tamimi Markets)
Commercial Food Processing & Curry Powder Re-packers in Dammam Industrial City 2
buyer_discovery_and_demand.mandatory_packaging: 25kg / 50kg multi-layer Kraft paper or food-grade HDPE woven bags with Arabic/English bilingual labeling, production date, expiry date, and batch code.

corridors.variety_grade: Garwa (Rabi) / Pol Red Onion (Medium to Big 45mm - 60mm)
corridors.hsn_description: Onions, shallots, garlic, leeks - Other than seed onion
corridors.destination: Domestic Consumption (Hyderabad / Chennai / Vijayawada) + Export Corridor (Bangladesh / UAE / Malaysia)
corridors.standard_lot_size: 25 Metric Tons (Standard 10-Wheeler Truckload / 1 x 40ft Reefer Container)

statutory_formalities.name: Local APMC Market Committee Mandi License
statutory_formalities.details: Commission Agent / Trader License under Telangana Agricultural Produce and Livestock Markets Act, 1966.

statutory_formalities.name: GST Registration (Exemption & Tax Structure)
statutory_formalities.details: Fresh whole onions are NIL rated (0% GST) under Notification No. 2/2017-Central Tax. GSTIN is still mandatory to generate e-Way bills.

statutory_formalities.name: GSTN e-Way Bill System Setup
statutory_formalities.details: Mandatory Part A & Part B generation for all onion truck movements exceeding ₹50,000 consignment value.

statutory_formalities.name: DGFT IEC & APEDA RCMC (For Export)
statutory_formalities.authority: Directorate General of Foreign Trade & APEDA
statutory_formalities.details: Mandatory for cross-border export shipments. Requires adherence to DGFT Minimum Export Price (MEP) notifications.

statutory_formalities.name: FSSAI Food Business Operator (FBO) Registration
statutory_formalities.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
statutory_formalities.details: State license for sorting, cleaning, mesh bagging, and wholesale storage.

sourcing_and_mandi.primary_mandi: Madhira Yard, Khammam Mandi, Kurnool Mandi (AP) & Lasalgaon/Pimpalgaon (Nashik Hub)

quality_specs.color_profile: Dark Pink to Deep Red, tight paper-like skin
quality_specs.sprouting_rot: Zero tolerance for sprouted, wet, or black-mold affected bulbs
quality_specs.moisture_loss: Cured under shade with 3%-5% allowable shrinkage factor

monthly_seasonal_index.procurement_advice: Strong Buy / Lowest Price / Storage Window

quality_and_lab_gateway.target_standards: AGMARK Rules for Edible Onions (Grading and Marking) Rules, 2004

key_parameters.importance: Long shelf life and storage endurance

authorized_nabl_labs: National Horticultural Research and Development Foundation (NHRDF), Hyderabad

plant_quarantine_pqis.authority: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS), Ministry of Agriculture
plant_quarantine_pqis.certificate_type: Plant Health / Phytosanitary Certificate for Fresh Perishables
plant_quarantine_pqis.inspection_hub: Regional Plant Quarantine Station, Chennai Port (INMAA1) / Hyderabad Ag Quarantine Cell
plant_quarantine_pqis.fumigation_protocol: Phosphine (Aluminium Phosphide) fumigation for storage bulbs or regulated cold treatment (+2 to +4°C continuous log)

multimodal_logistics.recommended_route: Madhira Packhouse -> Road Haulage via NH65 to Hyderabad (220 km) or Vijayawada (85 km) for domestic distribution; OR to Chennai Port (440 km) for sea export.
multimodal_logistics.port_of_discharge: Jebel Ali, Dubai (UAE) / Chittagong (Bangladesh) / Port Klang (Malaysia)
multimodal_logistics.container_spec: 40ft High-Cube Reefer Container (+2 to +4 deg C, 65% RH) or 25kg ventilated red leno mesh bags in ventilated open truck
multimodal_logistics.storage_advisory: Must never be stored in airtight plastic or poly bags; always use leno mesh bags with continuous air circulation.

customs_tariffs_and_rebates.mep_status: Monitored via DGFT Public Notices (subject to domestic inflation buffers)

trade_finance_and_risk.domestic_payment_terms: 100% Cash / RTGS at mandi gate-out before truck departure (prevents wholesale default)
trade_finance_and_risk.export_payment_terms: 100% Advance T/T or 50% Advance + 50% against scanned Bill of Lading (never accept DA terms on perishable vegetables)
trade_finance_and_risk.working_capital_financing: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) or MSME Working Capital Cash Credit limit against warehouse receipts (e-NWR)
trade_finance_and_risk.price_volatility_hedge: Trade in back-to-back pre-sold orders rather than speculative uncommitted stocking.

buyer_discovery_and_demand.demand_season: Surging domestic demand during festival months (Aug - Dec); export demand peaking in Gulf Ramadan seasons
buyer_archetypes: Hyderabad Bowenpally & Malakpet Wholesale APMC Commission Agents
Vijayawada Gollapudi & Guntur Wholesale Fruit & Vegetable Mandis
Dubai Al Aweer Fruit and Vegetable Central Market Importers & Packagers
buyer_discovery_and_demand.mandatory_packaging: 25kg or 50kg red ventilated Leno mesh bags with clear weight markings.
